name: proof-of-commitment
description: Supply chain risk scoring for npm, PyPI, Cargo (Rust), Go modules, and GitHub repos. 9 MCP tools score packages on behavioral signals — maintainer depth, download momentum, release consistency, OpenSSF Scorecard — to flag sole-maintainer packages before they become CVEs. CRITICAL = 1 maintainer + >10M weekly downloads. Web demo, GitHub Action for PR comments, REST API, and zero-install MCP server.
author: piiiico
